gbm_population_evidence.quote: FCGs (e.g., spouse/partner, parent, adult child) of patients diagnosed with HGG receiving any form of cancer treatment (including palliative intent) at MDACC.

candidate_evidence.quote: These sessions will involve simulation-based, caregiving skill training, and your caregiver will be taught skills to help support you

coder_notes: Behavioural caregiver-training trial; high-grade glioma, glioblastoma not named. control_arm_from_other_arms coded yes because the description refers to a randomised design with a waitlist control (WLC) group, though no registered arm is labelled as such.
